newsitem.title: germany: German shares down in pre-bourse after dlr slide.
newsitem.headline: German shares down in pre-bourse after dlr slide.

text.p: 0709 GMT - German shares are marked sharply lower in pre-bourse trade after the slide in the dollar against the mark and as German debt prices also tick lower. Little due in terms of corporate or economic news set to inspire market, which continues to be held back by expectations of further U.S. rate rise in May.
* IBIS-DAX index of electronic trade down 43.18 points to 3,318.02, June DAX futures down 47.0 points to 3,325.0.
* Dollar at 1.7034/41 marks, weaker but off early lows.
* Daimler-Benz continues lower, driven down by weak
dollar and reports of plans for higher tax on petrol.
